comment: Drills the tap drill (the modelled bore) with full retracts (G83) every 0.15 x the drill's diameter, deeper than 3 x its diameter. Starter template generated by tools/gen_library.py (task T-057): rules and numbers chosen by that script as conservative generic starting points, not copied from any table; compare with Machinery's Handbook (Industrial Press), 'Drilling' and 'Tapping'. Check them against your machine, tools and material before relying on them.
